review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Proceed before test implementation; final independent review required
review.notes: User explicitly requested every finding D01-D12 plus the attachment availability experience. Reviewed observable reading/touch/accessibility/loading/upload/HQ/state/shape outcomes, failure states, source ownership, and bounded synthetic verification. No new authentication, cross-session access relaxation, dependency installation, real-session send, native-device acceptance or Store publication is implied. D11/D12 continue through their already frozen Store candidate.

cases.description: Normal secondary App text remains legible in light and dark palettes
cases.setup: Use production palette backgrounds, surfaces, raised, waiting and selected composites.
cases.action: Compute rendered normal-text contrast for fg2/fg3, including selected and warning backgrounds.
cases.expected: Normal secondary text meets4.5:1; decorative/disabled tokens are separate, with no status-palette changes.

cases.description: Frequent touch actions have independent44-point targets
cases.setup: Render the real App composer with a removable image and normal/pending send states; use coarse-pointer Web controls.
cases.action: Inspect actual interactive bounds and activate add/expand/send/remove without activating neighboring image edit.
cases.expected: Each target is at least44pt/px, with separate remove/edit regions and correct action delivery.

cases.description: Own loading indicators and built-in state labels match across Web states
cases.setup: Exercise actual composer sending and row/page loading, both themes and reduced-motion preference.
cases.action: Enter/exit sending and inspect branded three-pane loading, accessible status text and rendered state labels.
cases.expected: The spinner is the same three-pane concept; reduced motion remains identifiable; built-in statuses use consistent lowercase without changing agent prose.

cases.description: HQ remains a separate role in narrow and wide browser layouts
cases.setup: Synthetic supervisor plus normal waiting/working/idle and external sessions.
cases.action: Render both layouts and change the supervisor status.
cases.expected: HQ stays a separate entry and never becomes an ordinary Idle/Working/Needs-you row; normal counts/groups remain correct.

cases.description: Settings and session controls expose usable accessibility context
cases.setup: Render production settings switch/action rows and two same-named sessions with different location/status.
cases.action: Inspect accessible labels, values, checked/disabled state, hints and action delivery.
cases.expected: Controls expose the setting/session identity and current state without merging unrelated children; actual spoken VoiceOver/TalkBack remains separately unverified.

cases.description: Global appearance is discoverable outside Terminal settings
cases.setup: Render settings with global appearance values and terminal/input settings.
cases.action: Locate Appearance and switch among system/light/dark.
cases.expected: Global Appearance has its own group and changes the existing shared theme preference; terminal-specific settings retain their scope.

cases.description: Thumbnail upload stages reflect real transfer and server confirmation
cases.setup: Synthetic Web XHR with queued image, unknown total, partial transfer, loaded=total, delayed server response and failure.
cases.action: Exercise actual upload progress and completion handlers through each state; retain editable draft/attachment on failure.
cases.expected: Queued/preparing/uploading/saving/failure are shown on the thumbnail; no fake percentage or completion before success; successful files retain original identity.

cases.description: Mac menu-bar status remains distinguishable without color
cases.setup: Production status glyphs for waiting/working/idle/running/empty with awake modifier.
cases.action: Compare non-color status geometry and render representative light/dark grayscale glyphs.
cases.expected: Brand identity persists but status changes include distinct shapes; awake modifier remains distinct; actual wallpaper/menu-bar acceptance is separately recorded.

cases.description: Unavailable attachment feedback does not falsely assert the file was deleted
cases.setup: Resolve an attachment unavailable to this conversation; separately exercise network/permission/size failures.
cases.action: Read the real shared/native error presentation and inspect available recovery actions.
cases.expected: The message states current-conversation unavailability and offers a new-link recovery; network/permission errors remain distinct. Strict session/home binding is unchanged.
